rationale: Contract clause 4.2 fixes EUR 1.00 = USD 1.10 for invoices dated 1 Jan - 31 Mar 2026, so the PO price of EUR 210.00/EACH converts to exactly USD 231.00 — the invoiced price. Per clause 7 and 11.1 this conversion is normalisation, not a defect. Receipt GR-7711 confirms 40 EACH against 40 on the PO, and recomputed tax at 7.5% of USD 9,240.00 is USD 693.00, matching the invoice exactly (clause 5). Clean match; net payable USD 9,933.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
